verses.english: “There are these two kinds of charity.
Charity in things of the flesh and charity in the teaching.
These are the two kinds of charity.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ pariccāgānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammapariccāgo”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of charity is a charity in the teaching.”
